notes.text: Read-only audit. No source/skill/prediction changes, no new API calls, no uncompleted evaluation labels opened. Exact final array and test-score comparison belongs to the separate root validation.

Retrieval and alternative generation are protocol-required stages with LLM choice within their action space. Paired historical diagnostics and no-history recent-fit tools are automatic protocol work. Tool coverage alone is not evidence of autonomous LLM discovery or predictive gain.

Historical diagnostic QS is observed/mature evidence, may be selection exposed or pretraining-overlap unknown, and is not future test accuracy. Disagreeing with the lowest historical QS is not by itself a bug.
